channel.title: Daily MYRSS Digest
channel.description: 26 November 2026: eight world-affairs selections and two cultural wind-down selections. Based on repository feeds collected around 07:00 UTC; Reuters original reports checked.

item.title: de Volkskrant | Dutch resistance to US involvement in ASML export decisions
item.description: The Netherlands opposes American involvement in decisions on exports of ASML machines to China, the newspaper reports. RSS headline only.

item.title: de Volkskrant | Carbon import levies cost over €120 million in first half-year
item.description: The newspaper reports the cost of new carbon levies for large importers. RSS headline only.

item.title: New York Times | Houthis gain ground in Yemen
item.description: The Iran-backed movement is gaining strategically important territory against Saudi Arabia and its Yemeni allies. RSS summary.

item.title: New York Times | South African president wins impeachment reprieve
item.description: A court discarded a report suggesting Cyril Ramaphosa may have concealed a theft of more than half a million US dollars. RSS summary.

item.title: Follow the Money | Medicinal cannabis supply disrupted by Dutch producer bankruptcy
item.description: FTM reports that Bedrocan's bankruptcy threatens access for tens of thousands of patients in the Netherlands and abroad after the health ministry ended its contract. RSS summary.

item.title: Follow the Money | Podcast: Managing increasingly crowded Earth orbits
item.description: Journalist Dimitri Tokmetzis discusses orbital congestion, satellite safety and society's dependence on space infrastructure. RSS summary; podcast selection.

item.title: Reuters | Trump and Rutte warn against widening Ukraine war
item.description: The US president and NATO secretary-general jointly urged Russia to avoid escalation and discussed defence investment. European allies and Ukraine seek European participation in peace negotiations. Original Reuters report checked.

item.title: Reuters | Vietnam seeks trade deal as US tariffs threaten exports
item.description: Vietnam is pursuing an agreement after Washington threatened tariffs of up to 35%, putting apparel, footwear and electronics exporters under pressure. Original Reuters report checked.

item.title: The New Yorker | The Best Books of 2026 So Far
item.description: Editors and critics recommend notable fiction, nonfiction and poetry. RSS summary; wind-down selection.

item.title: The New Yorker | A Thanksgiving Tradition of Rewatching The Last Waltz
item.description: Hanif Abdurraqib revisits Martin Scorsese's documentary of the Band's farewell concert, fifty years after the performance. RSS summary; wind-down selection.
